_comment: 状态挂在身上 (DECISIONS「战斗运功」): what a figure's conditions look like on the figure itself, in a fight and out of it (presentation/voxel/actors/voxel_states.gd; the view reads the character's state every `check_seconds`). marks: by condition id (daemon/condition/: ConditionIds) — kind: one of bubbles / flush / drowse / frost / band / drip; colour; and what the body does under it: sway (radians the body rocks from side to side: drunk), shiver (units it trembles: cold), nod (0..1 of the worn stoop: drugged). wound: an open wound's mark, shown while 气's ceiling (eff_kee) is under `below` of its maximum and the condition `stopped_by` is not on the figure (0: never shown). weary: the stoop and the panting of one whose 气 is low — none at `from` of its maximum, whole at `full`; lean (radians the body bends forward), arms (radians the arms sink), pant (how much faster and deeper the breath). Presentation only: nothing here changes a rule or a number.
